metadata.description: MemBrain: long-term memory for Claude Code. Lessons from your past sessions, recalled per prompt behind a fitted gate. A different approach to RAG: instead of trusting top-k similarity, it decides at write time which memories compete, and stays silent unless one clearly fits.
